lineage: FilterPy (2014-, Labbe): reference implementations of the Kalman family (KF/EKF/UKF), particle filters, and other Bayesian filters, written for clarity alongside the book 'Kalman and Bayesian Filters in Python'; carries example systems (a noisy nonlinear plant) AND the estimators that recover their hidden state
version: github.com/rlabbe/filterpy master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)
entry_points: filterpy.kalman.KalmanFilter / UnscentedKalmanFilter; filterpy.monte_carlo (systematic_resample) for the particle filter

example.command: Techne harness: a 1-D constant-velocity target with process+measurement noise, estimated by a KF; check RMSE below the raw sensor
example.output: a filtered track with RMSE < the sensor noise

upstream_docs: Labbe, Kalman and Bayesian Filters in Python (the book)

human_capability_summary.built_to: estimate the hidden state of a dynamical system from noisy measurements across the whole Bayesian-filter family -- linear (KF), nonlinear (EKF/UKF), and non-Gaussian (particle filter)
human_capability_summary.pressure: nonlinearity and non-Gaussian noise where the plain Kalman filter fails; hidden state that must be tracked through a noisy, possibly multimodal posterior
human_capability_summary.success_means: a state estimate that tracks truth with low error and calibrated uncertainty, even when the system is nonlinear or the posterior is multimodal

known_human_problem_solved: Bayesian state estimation across the filter family
human_environmental_pressure: noisy observation, nonlinear dynamics, non-Gaussian / multimodal uncertainty, hidden state
human_failure_condition: a diverged filter (EKF linearisation error) or a degenerate particle set (all weight on one particle) loses the track entirely
behavioral_entry_point: ADVERSARIAL PAIR within this repo: the example systems GENERATE process+measurement noise (the pressure) and the filters RECOVER the state (the response). Raise noise, add nonlinearity, or drop measurements to break the estimator; force particle degeneracy by shrinking the particle count.

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run filterpy-labbe
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: estimate the hidden state of a dynamical system from noisy measurements across the whole Bayesian-filter family -- linear (KF), nonlinear (EKF/UKF), and non-Gaussian (particle filter)
